activity_summary: At two the plot was The Comedy of Errors, and your side was Egeon. You open, and you are idle until the end. Across the water the Rose had the second Hercules. You did not cross.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played Egeon, and did not cross the water.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in Egeon, and the second Hercules
